about_short_description.short_description: Sprinto automates cloud security compliance, managing risk and controls with automated checks and remediation.

product.name: Continuous Security & Compliance Platform
product.description: A cloud-native platform that automates security compliance management by integrating with cloud infrastructure to monitor controls, assess risks, and collect audit evidence continuously.

product.name: Audit Management Hub
product.description: A centralized platform to plan, execute, and manage security audits with automated evidence collection and real-time collaboration with auditors.

identifier.value: Compliance Automation with Pre-built Controls and Frameworks

product.name: Compliance Automation with Pre-built Controls and Frameworks
product.description: A feature set offering pre-mapped controls and automated workflows for over 20 security compliance frameworks to streamline compliance implementation and maintenance.

product.name: Integrated Risk Assessment and Management
product.description: A tool to assess, prioritize, and manage security risks by mapping them to controls and automating risk treatment workflows.

product.name: Built-in Lightweight Mobile Device Management (MDM)
product.description: An internal MDM solution that monitors device security settings like screen lock, antivirus status, OS versions, and encryption to support compliance requirements.
